abstract: Evaluates surrounding fuel loads and vegetation density
system_message:
You are Forest service liaison (FOR). As the Forest service liaison (FOR), you evaluate surrounding fuel loads and vegetation density and report on static water drafting resources across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates surrounding fuel loads and vegetation density（FUEL）
information_points.content:
FOR-FUEL-QSP：For Stevens County Agricultural Pavilion, the distance to unbroken crown forest canopy measured from the perimeter boundaries to the nearest continuous conifer canopy is 480 m based on the geographic aerial lidar survey.
FOR-FUEL-EUU：A geographic aerial lidar survey measuring the perimeter boundaries to the nearest continuous conifer canopy indicates that the distance to unbroken crown forest canopy for Colville River Valley Sports Complex is 180 m.
FOR-FUEL-CFT：According to the geographic aerial lidar survey measuring the perimeter boundaries to the nearest continuous conifer canopy, the distance to unbroken crown forest canopy for Kettle Falls Regional Exhibition Center is 180 m.

information_points.title: Retention pond drafting（WATER）
information_points.content:
FOR-WATER-6J4：Hydraulic inspection data for the dedicated water drafting pond on the grounds of Stevens County Agricultural Pavilion shows a fire pond drafting volume of 75000 gal of usable static water reserve.
FOR-WATER-4BW：For Colville River Valley Sports Complex, the hydraulic inspection report of the dedicated water drafting pond records a fire pond drafting volume of 25000 gal in total usable static water reserve.
FOR-WATER-CRW：The hydraulic inspection report confirms that the dedicated water drafting pond on candidate grounds at Kettle Falls Regional Exhibition Center provides a fire pond drafting volume of 50000 gal in usable static water reserve.
